exe_needs_args: This .exe package needs silent-install arguments. Without them the installer opens a window on the endpoint and blocks there.
exe_args_required: Install arguments are required for .exe packages
no_uninstall_args: {name} has no uninstall arguments. An uninstaller with no silent switches opens a window on the endpoint. Edit the package and set them first.
deployment_initiated: Deployment initiated! {total} target(s) queued, {live} dispatched live.
removal_initiated: Removal initiated! {total} target(s) queued, {live} dispatched live.
title: Software Deployment
subtitle: Silent multi-platform distribution with integrity verification and progress tracking
no_packages: No software packages in repository. Click "Upload Package" to add your first installer.
no_deployments: No deployments initiated yet. Select a package and click "Deploy" to start a rollout.
install_args_hint_exe: Required. Case-sensitive: NSIS requires uppercase /S. Inno Setup requires /VERYSILENT /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES /NORESTART.
install_args_hint: Leave blank to use the default silent flags.
file_needs_args: {name} has no silent-install arguments yet. Click a preset above or enter arguments before uploading.
uninstall_args_hint: Used when remote software removal is dispatched. If blank, remote uninstallation will not be permitted.
edit_install_args_hint: Case-sensitive switches used during unattended deployment (e.g. /S for NSIS).
edit_uninstall_args_hint: Required for software removal via Software Deployments.
uninstall_refused: {name} has no uninstall arguments. An uninstaller with no silent switches opens a window on the endpoint and waits for a person, so this deployment will be refused. Edit the package and set its uninstall arguments first.
uninstall_explainer: The agent finds the program on the endpoint and removes it there. Nothing is downloaded, and a package that is not installed on a machine is reported as already compliant rather than as a failure.
no_endpoints: No enrolled endpoints found. Agents must be registered first.
device_online: {hostname} is online via WebSocket. Deployment will dispatch immediately.
device_offline: {hostname} is offline. Task will queue and execute when agent reconnects.
no_groups: No device groups exist. Create groups in Device Management or select Single Endpoint.
all_compatible_endpoints: All active compatible endpoints in fleet
security_notice: Online endpoints receive execution triggers immediately via persistent WebSocket transport. Packages are cryptographically validated against SHA-256 before silent background installation.
no_tasks: No tasks generated for this deployment.
delete_confirm: Delete package "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
